description: Inspect projects, database schemas, API contracts and usage in MCPBackend. Create projects and tables, configure authentication and row-level security, create server-side API keys and webhooks, and manage team access. Security changes can expose or revoke access and should be reviewed before execution. Project records use the separate data-plane API.
